studio.layerbreak.moeglicheLayerwechselN: {length} possible layer breaks. Seamless cells come last (a break there may stutter briefly); "padding sectors" are inserted before the titleset to align the boundary to 16 sectors.
studio.layerbreak.keineMoeglichenLayerwe: No possible layer breaks found (fits on one layer, or no cell meets the rules).
studio.tools.aendertDieBezeichnungDirekt: Changes the label directly in the image (ISO 9660, Joliet and UDF; checksums are recalculated). Allowed: A–Z, 0–9 and _.
studio.tools.dvdVideoImageIso: Choose a DVD-Video image (.iso) – or "Cancel" and choose a folder
studio.tools.schreibtEineLayoutDatei: Writes a layout file next to the image: .dvd (dual layer only), .cue (one data track) or .mds (Alcohol/Daemon Tools – compatibility not verified).
studio.tools.leerLassenBeiEiner: Leave empty for a single layer.
studio.tools.greiftBeiGeschwindigkeitAut: Applies at speed "Auto": the first matching row wins (media ID contains the text, drive contains the text or is empty). The speed is rounded to the nearest supported one.
studio.views.isoBinCueDvd: Burn an ISO, BIN/CUE, DVD or MDS file
studio.views.imageImHintergrundBauen: Build the image in the background and burn it directly
studio.views.discAlsIsoSichern: Back up disc as ISO (with MD5, layout file)
studio.views.mitEinemImageVergleichen: Compare with an image or check readability
studio.views.nochNichtsAusgewaehltDateie: Nothing selected yet. Add files or folders – a single VIDEO_TS/BDMV folder is recognized as a disc.
studio.views.alsDiscAufbauenDateireihenf: Build as {what} disc (file order, layout) or as plain data?
studio.views.label: Label {label} · {fmtSectors}
studio.views.einDvdMdsNeben: A .dvd/.mds next to the image provides the layer break (dual layer); a .cue is read with one data track (MODE1/2048 or /2352).
studio.views.mitUeberpruefungWirdDas: With verification, the image is first created as a temporary file (needs space in the temp folder).
studio.views.dasImageWirdBeim: While burning, the image is built straight into the ring buffer (no temporary file).
studio.views.teilenLayoutDateiLesefehler: Split: {split}, layout file: {layout_file}, read errors {r} (Settings ▸ Read). Copy-protected discs (CSS/AACS) are not decrypted.
studio.views.esWerdenNullenAuf: Zeros are written to the inserted blank disc. The disc is used up afterwards (only rewritable media can be erased). In "IMAPI" mode this is a real burn – a real test mode only exists with "SPTI direct" on DVD-R/-RW.
studio.views.derGraphZeigtGeschwindigkei: The graph shows speed and buffers across the whole disc.
studio.views.cssModalText: This image contains scrambled DVD sectors (CSS copy protection). A burnt recordable disc will not be playable on standalone DVD players or computers without decryption software.
studio.views.wasMoechtenSieTun: What would you like to do?

studio.settings.layerwechselInNahtloserZ: Layer break in a seamless cell
studio.settings.autoDvdBeiDual: Auto: .dvd for dual layer, otherwise none.
studio.settings.unlesbareSektorenWerdenM: Unreadable sectors are filled with zeros and listed.
studio.settings.stapelAuswerfenUndNaechs: Batch: eject and wait for the next disc

studio.settings.titelsetSektorenTtSrpt: Adjust titleset sectors (TT_SRPT) to the layout
studio.settings.kopierschutzFlagDerM2ts: Reset copy-protection flag of the M2TS packets
studio.settings.setztNurDieTp: Only sets the TP_extra_header bits; the flag in the .clpi stays untouched.
studio.settings.nachJederKopieWird: After each copy the disc is ejected and the drive waits for a blank disc.
studio.settings.imageNachErfolgreichemBr: Delete image after a successful burn
studio.settings.abweichungenMeldenAberAl: Report differences but count as passed
studio.settings.graphDatenAufzeichnenUnd: Record graph data and save as .ibg

studio.main.bookTypAendernBitsetting: Changing the book type (bitsetting) is vendor-specific and not implemented.
studio.main.sptiDirektEigeneSchreibschle: "SPTI direct" (own write loop) has only been tested against a simulated drive.
studio.main.graphDateienIbgHaben: Graph files (.ibg) have no ImgBurn checksum line.
studio.main.vorgangWirdAbgebrochenDanach: Operation is being cancelled – the window can be closed afterwards.

settings.dieserRechnerHatLogische: This computer has {cpuCount} logical cores; the default is half ({max}). Each ffmpeg process uses several cores itself – more parallel encodes mainly need more memory and disk speed.
settings.leerlaufNurWennDer: Idle (only when the PC is doing nothing else)
settings.einstellungenFuerDasErzeugte: Settings for the generated DVD-Video or Blu-ray. Subsections: TV format, encoding and video processing.
settings.menuesUndTitelWerden: Menus and titles are generated in the selected standard (NTSC: 720×480, 29.97 fps). Half D1 and SIF apply to the titles only – menus stay in full resolution. These titles are always 4:3; widescreen videos get black bars.
settings.bluRayTitelSind: Blu-ray titles are always 16:9 with square pixels (BT.709); 4:3 videos get side bars. Cinema films (23.976/24 fps) keep their frame rate; otherwise the TV standard applies: 1080p at 25 or 29.97 fps (flagged as 1080i), 720p at 50 or 59.94 fps. The frame rate is the same for the whole disc.
settings.nurEinVideoPro: Only one video per Blu-ray (no playlist)
settings.mehrereVideosWerdenSonst: Otherwise several videos are combined into one playlist that plays through completely after the disc is inserted. With this option on, Blu-ray conversion can only be started with a single video.
settings.spieltBeiMenuesAus: Plays the intro of the pages (fade in/out, zoom) for menus from ConvertX templates (DVD, Blu-ray, AVCHD) before the buttons appear. Off: the finished pages show immediately. On Blu-ray/AVCHD, paging within a menu does not replay the intro; on DVD it does.
settings.hw_accel_mode_hint: Encodes Blu-ray/AVCHD videos on this GPU and picks the GPU decoder. Falls back to x264/CPU automatically if the GPU does not work. 1080i frame rates (25 / 29.97 fps) always use x264.
settings.spKurzeLaufzeitHoechste: SP – short play time, highest quality (up to 8,500 kbps)
settings.mpMittlereLaufzeitBis: MP – medium play time (up to 6,000 kbps)
settings.lpLangeLaufzeitBis: LP – long play time (up to 4,000 kbps)
settings.automatischVerteiltDenPlatz: "Automatic" distributes the disc space across all videos (bitrate 1,000–8,500 kbps, Blu-ray 4,000–35,000 kbps). MP and LP cap the bitrate – short projects then become smaller (Blu-ray: SP up to 35,000, MP up to 20,000, LP up to 12,000 kbps). With LP, DVD titles below 3,000 kbps are encoded in Half D1 automatically.
settings.wirdVerwendetWennUnten: Used when "Custom" is chosen as the medium at the bottom left (DVD only). DVD-5 = 4,300 MB, DVD-9 = 7,950 MB, BD-25 = 22,900 MB, BD-50 = 45,800 MB.
settings.dieQuellvideosWerdenAuf: Source videos are decoded on the graphics card when a working decoder is found – otherwise automatically on the CPU. Relieves the CPU with many parallel encodes; with 4K material and no CUDA it may be slower.
settings.verzichtetAufTrellisQuantisieru: Skips trellis quantization: about 40 % faster, with slightly lower picture quality. For test runs and drafts.
settings.abweichendeQuellenBekommenSchwa: Sources with a different aspect ratio get black bars (letterbox or pillarbox).
settings.letterboxDasBildBehaelt: Letterbox: the picture keeps its aspect ratio, the rest turns black. Pan & Scan: the picture fills the whole frame, the overhang is cut off in the middle. Stretch: the picture is distorted regardless of its aspect ratio.
settings.algorithmusMitDemDas: Algorithm used to enlarge or shrink the picture.
settings.automatischNurVideosDie: Automatic: only videos flagged as interlaced. "Never" can produce comb artifacts when interlaced material is scaled.
settings.dieDvdBeginntBeim: The DVD starts with the first video as soon as it is inserted.
settings.nachJedemVideoFolgt: After each video the next one follows directly, without a detour through the menu.
settings.nachDemLetztenVideo: After the last video, the DVD starts again from the first.
settings.einVideoWirdWiederholt: A video is repeated; "Play all" starts over after the last one.
settings.nachDerWiedergabeZum: Return to the title menu after playback
settings.ohneWirkungSolangeDie: Has no effect while the endless loop is active.
settings.sonstGehtEsZurueck: Otherwise it goes back to the video's own menu (chapters/settings).
settings.keinRootMenuePro: No root menu per video (chapters, settings, back, play) – the video opens its chapter menu directly.
settings.keinTitelmenueBeiNur: Do not create a title menu for a single video
settings.dieDvdStartetDann: The DVD then starts directly in the menu or with the video.
settings.wennEinTextZu: When a text is too long
settings.hauptmenueStummVideomenuesMit: Main menu silent, video menus with their own audio
settings.hauptmenueMitEigenerAudiodatei: Main menu with its own audio file, video menus with their own audio
settings.dasMenueEinesVideos: The menu of a video (root, chapters, settings) always plays that video's audio – chapter pages from their first chapter.
settings.audiodateiFuerDasHauptmenue: Audio file for the main menu
settings.nurFuerVideosOhne: Only for videos without their own chapter marks.
settings.kuerzereVideosBekommenNur: Shorter videos get only one chapter.
settings.dieVorlageMussC: The template must contain <c> for the chapter number.
settings.cWirdDurchDie: <c> is replaced by the chapter number. Applies to chapters without their own title. Videos that are already loaded keep their chapter list.
settings.untertitelInDieserSprache: Subtitles in this language become the DVD's first subtitle track.
settings.sonstSindUntertitelBeim: Otherwise subtitles are off at start.
settings.tonspurenInDieserSprache: Audio tracks in this language become the DVD's first (default) audio track.
settings.automatischPassendeAc3: Automatic: matching AC-3/DTS tracks are copied losslessly (DVD: AC-3 up to 448 kbps, DTS core; Blu-ray: AC-3 up to 640 kbps, DTS/DTS-HD; AVCHD: AC-3), everything else becomes AC-3. LPCM is available for Blu-ray (up to 8 channels, 24 bit) and AVCHD (stereo, 16 bit); on DVD, AC-3 is written instead. Trimmed videos and normalized tracks are always re-encoded.
settings.intelligentSpurenGleicherSprach: Smart: tracks of the same language stay distinguishable ("Spanish - Latino", otherwise "Spanish (2)"). Applies to the track list and the disc's settings menus.
settings.gleichtDieLautstaerkeAller: Adjusts the loudness of all audio tracks to −23 LUFS (two passes per track: measure, then apply). The tracks are re-encoded in the process.
settings.wirdAufDieNaechste: Rounded down to the next speed the drive supports; the value applies to the respective medium (Blu-ray: 1x = 36 Mbit/s, 4.5 MB/s). It can be changed per disc in the burn dialog.
settings.liestDieDiscVollstaendig: Reads the whole disc back and compares it with the image.
settings.dasImageDvdUdf: The image (DVD: UDF 1.02, Blu-ray: UDF 2.50) stays next to the project folder.
settings.dvdOrdnerUndArbeitsdateien: Delete DVD folder and work files after a successful burn
settings.loeschtDenErzeugtenDvd: Deletes the generated DVD folder, the image and the work folder – only if the folder contains nothing but VIDEO_TS/AUDIO_TS.
settings.explorerNichtOeffnenLaufwerk: Do not open Explorer / do not eject the drive
settings.ohneDieseOptionWird: Without this option the disc is ejected after burning, or the DVD folder is opened in Explorer if nothing is burned.
settings.dvdrwMitAltenDaten: DVD±RW discs with old data are erased/overwritten automatically; the automatic burn start (countdown) then applies to them as well.
settings.ordnernameDerDvdUnd: Folder name of the DVD and volume label of the disc. A–Z, 0–9 and _, at most {MAX_LABEL} characters; empty = automatic (fallback {DEFAULT_LABEL}).
menuEditor.titelmenuesLiegenImHauptmenue: Title menus live in the DVD's main menu ("Title" key); the first one appears on insertion. Root menus belong to a title ("Menu" key during playback).
menuEditor.ziehenVerschiebtAlleEck: Dragging moves all, corner handles resize all. Shift+click: extend selection · Alt+click: a single element (also within a group) · Drag on empty space: selection box.
menuEditor.name: Name
menuEditor.bewegtesMenueWirdAls: Moving menu: encoded as a loop of this length.
menuEditor.textButtonsLeuchtenIn: Text buttons light up in the shape of the text; image and video buttons with a frame.
menuEditor.tonUndUntertitelwahlGibt: Audio and subtitle selection exists only in the root and settings menus of a title.
menuEditor.eineDvdMenueseiteZeigt: A DVD menu page shows at most 3 different color pairs; buttons with the same highlight color need the same activation color.
menuEditor.dasVideoLaeuftIm: The video loops in the menu; a picture shows the start position.
menuEditor.buttonsKoennenNichtGedreht: Buttons cannot be rotated (DVD hit boxes are rectangles)
menuEditor.neuerEntwurfFuerDie: New draft for the {length} current videos – the saved layout was made for other videos ("Undo" brings it back).
menuEditor.layoutFuer720Entworfen: Layout designed for 720×{H} – scaled to 720×{tvCanvas} for {tv}.
menuEditor.speichernDialogKonnteNicht: Save dialog could not be opened: {e}
burn.wirklichAbbrechenRohlingWird: Really cancel? (the blank disc will be ruined)
edit.mindestensZweiKapitelIm: At least two chapters are needed within the selection.
edit.ungueltigeZeitDerAusschnitt: Invalid time. The section must be at least {MIN_SECS} s long and lie within {fmtPrecise}.
edit.hierKannKeinKapitel: A chapter cannot be set here (start/end, an existing chapter nearby, or outside the selection).
edit.nurDenGewaehltenAusschnitt: Use only the selected section in the video (cut off intro and credits). Chapters are trimmed to the section. Preview in 480p; seeking takes a moment.
edit.diesesVideoHatKeine: This video has no video track.
edit.zuschnittErkanntObenUnten: Crop detected: top {top}, bottom {bottom}, left {left}, right {right} pixels.
edit.schwarzeRaenderAbschneidenDie: Cut off black borders: drag the edges in the picture, enter pixel values or let them be detected automatically. The result is fitted into the disc's picture format with black bars.
main.inTitelAufteilenMit: Split "{label}" into {length} titles? "Undo split" merges them again.
main.beideVideosLaufenHinter: Both videos play one after the other behind a single menu entry (same number of audio and subtitle tracks required)
main.mergeTrackMismatch: This video has {audio} audio and {subs} subtitle tracks, but the group's first video ({first}) differs. Merged videos need equal counts.
main.videoqualitaetGruenUeber10: Video quality: green above 10,000 kbps, yellow 5,000–10,000 kbps, red below 5,000 kbps
main.videoqualitaetGruenUeber15: Video quality: green above 15,000 kbps, yellow 8,000–15,000 kbps, red below 8,000 kbps
main.videoqualitaetGruenUeber2: Video quality: green above 2,500 kbps, yellow 1,200–2,500 kbps, red below 1,200 kbps
main.bd50WaehlenOder: Choose BD-50 or deselect audio tracks.
main.videosKuerzenOderTonspuren: Shorten videos or deselect audio tracks.
main.avchdDvd9Waehlen: Choose AVCHD (DVD-9) or deselect audio tracks.
main.dvd9WaehlenOder: Choose DVD-9 or deselect audio tracks.
main.nurEinVideoPro: Only one video per Blu-ray allowed (setting "Only one video per Blu-ray").
main.bluRayMenuesBewegen: Blu-ray menus move when the template has video slots
main.beimEigenenMenueBestimmen: With a custom menu, the videos/audio in the layout decide whether a menu moves
main.linksEinVideoHinzufuegen: Add or select a video on the left.
main.diesesVideoHatKeine: This video has no audio track.
main.passendeAc3Dts: Matching AC-3/DTS tracks are copied unchanged, all others are converted to AC-3 (setting "Audio mode"; DVD: at most {MAX_AUDIO} tracks).
main.spurnamenKonntenNichtAktualisiert: Track names could not be updated: {e}
main.textUntertitelSrtAss: Text subtitles (SRT/ASS) are rendered as DVD subtitles. Bitmap subtitles (Blu-ray PGS, DVD VobSub) are converted and reduced to 3 colors. DVB and XSUB subtitles are not supported.
main.zeitenDerQuelldateiIm: · times of the source file; {effChapters} remain in the selection ({fmtTime}–{fmtTime2})
main.brennstudioKonnteNichtGeoeffnet: Burn Studio could not be opened: {ev}
main.menueEditorKonnteNicht: Menu editor could not be opened: {ev}
main.nochKeinEigenesMenue: No custom menu yet. The editor creates a draft from the project's videos that you can design freely.
main.titelmenueSRootMenue: {titleMenus} title menu(s), {rootMenus} root menu(s), {buttons} buttons, {moving} moving menu(s)
main.diesesLayoutWurdeFuer: This layout was made for other videos. Opening the editor creates a new draft from the current videos ("Undo" brings the old one back).
main.dieMenuevorlageGiltFuer: The menu template applies to the whole project (main menu and submenus of all titlesets).
main.auchNameDesDvd: Also the name of the DVD folder: <output folder>\<heading>\VIDEO_TS. Defaults to the name of the first video.
main.fehlendeUntermenuesRootKapitel: Missing submenus (root/chapters/settings) are filled in from a template of the same family.
main.derTemporaereArbeitsordnerWurde: {message}. The temporary work folder was deleted.
main.bereitVideosPerDrag: Ready. Load videos via drag & drop or "Add videos".
